final_rationale: The verdict changes because the Actor materially narrowed the claim being advanced, not because any new admissible evidence was added. On the same evidentiary record, clean certification remains unsupported: the refund-workflow weakness is unresolved, the runbook is draft and missing required policy fields, the model-card draft is misaligned with the evidence, and no approved risk acceptance is in evidence. However, the Actor's final position no longer asks the auditor to accept those gaps as resolved. Instead, it accepts that policy requires disclosure of the limitation and treats certification as defensible only on an explicitly caveated basis with monitoring. That narrower position is supportable from admissible evidence alone. The distinction is that caveated compliance is supportable because it preserves the unresolved limitation as a live compliance predicate requiring disclosure, whereas clean compliance would require evidence or approvals that are not present.
remaining_concerns: The enterprise refund-workflow slice remains below target, concentrated in refund-policy summarization.
The draft runbook is still not an approved mitigation and still lacks at least the rollback threshold and review date required by policy.
The current model-card draft still says there are no known material limitations, which is not aligned with the admissible record.
No approved risk acceptance is in evidence.
Any launch decision remains compliant only if it is explicitly caveated through disclosure; the record still does not support clean no-caveat certification.
